SELECT m.meeting_id, m.title, m.start_time, m.end_time, m.location_type, m.meeting_state, m.location, COUNT(p_all.participant_id) AS participantCount
FROM MEETING m
INNER JOIN MEETING_PARTICIPANT p_me ON m.meeting_id = p_me.meeting_id AND p_me.user_id = #{userId}
LEFT JOIN MEETING_PARTICIPANT p_all ON m.meeting_id = p_all.meeting_id
m.end_time > NOW()
m.end_time <= NOW()
AND m.meeting_state = #{state}
GROUP BY m.meeting_id ORDER BY m.start_time ASC
